purpose: Verify the native XKB compiled-output path for task-local display testing
method: TLS-verified curl downloads from Debian Sources, source inspection and installed-binary strings inspection

files.rights: Original Silicon Graphics permissive license in source header

finding: OutputDirectory uses the writable compile-time XKM_OUTPUT_DIR, which is /var/lib/xkb in this binary. A private namespace bind from task-local ignored artifacts at /var/lib/xkb provides native compiled keymap storage.
limitations: This source inspection does not establish a browser test result.
Actual namespace/display/browser execution belongs to the QA runner.
